verdict.rationale: Reflect publishes a documented REST API with OAuth 2 and PKCE, bearer-token auth, and an OpenAPI 3.0 spec on openpm. The spec covers graphs, links, appending to daily notes, creating notes, and users/me. The surface is deliberately narrow: because notes are end-to-end encrypted, the API cannot read note contents, so you can only append, create, and list bookmarks rather than fully drive the product. No spec is served at the vendor's own openapi paths. Missing for 10: reading, searching or editing note contents via the API; broader coverage of product features (AI, search, publishing); a versioning or deprecation policy; a sandbox or test environment; independent hands-on corroboration.
